verdict.rationale: NVIDIA Project G-Assist is described as an AI assistant that helps tune, control, and optimize your system, which offers a narrow form of AI-generated suggestions based on system data, but this is limited to hardware/performance tuning rather than general insights from a user's broader data. Missing for 10: evidence of AI insights/suggestions derived from general user data (documents, analytics, files) rather than just system telemetry, and any independent hands-on validation of G-Assist's insight quality.
